source.geometryMethod: deterministic card, segmented-trunk and closed-caster generator
source.textureMethod: four transparent ImageGen foliage sources conditioned into one alpha-safe PBR atlas

imageGenSources.promptSummary: Transparent photoreal temperate autumn branch cluster with burnt orange, ochre, muted red and olive leaves, visible twigs and irregular gaps under flat overcast light.
Transparent photoreal broad spruce/pine branch cluster with dark needles, visible twigs and gaps; no whole-tree or Christmas-tree symmetry.
Transparent top-oblique radial date-palm fronds with realistic leaflets and gaps; no trunk, coconuts, ground or low-poly styling.
Transparent photoreal fan clump of thin tapered grass blades with natural crossings and gaps; no soil, pot, flowers or low-poly treatment.

material.name: extended-foliage-v1-pbr
material.atlasLayout: 2x2: autumn branch, composed conifer crown with bounded asymmetric tier profiles plus dedicated fissured bark plate and recessed opaque caster swatch, palm fronds, grass tuft; autumn and palm trunks use mip-safe opaque point samples while the conifer trunk spans its non-overlapping bark plate
material.ktx2Orientation: The encoded mip chains are vertically flipped at cook time to reproduce ordinary TextureLoader upload orientation for GLB UVs; compressed KTX2 uploads cannot apply UNPACK_FLIP_Y at runtime.

reviews.note: WebGPU cardinal proof that the layered autumn crown retains a grounded medium-brown trunk in every view.
Native-WebGPU overhead proof that smaller offset crown clusters replace the rejected single radial sunflower card.
Native-WebGPU cardinal proof of the richer coherent pine silhouette, bounded branch/needle variation and separate fissured brown bark plate in every view.
WebGPU proof of the halo-free radial frond read and segmented grounded trunk.
WebGPU proof of halo-free realistic alpha grass at an eight-triangle LOD0.
Live WebGPU overhead proof that both stable grass identities submit consistent narrow 24-triangle casters matching their blade clumps instead of broad oval patches.

rejections.reason: The 8 px opaque swatch passed close LOD0 review but averaged into transparent texels in distant mips, erasing trunks. Autumn and palm now use 33+ texels of opaque guard; conifer uses a dedicated fissured bark plate.

Large cards all crossed the trunk centre and one full-width horizontal card projected the complete branch texture as a flat sunflower from above. The accepted crown uses layered offset tilted and recessed top clusters with dedicated overhead review.
Nine cards exposed too much pole-like trunk; the later 15-card candidate improved isolated cardinals but was ultimately rejected by live gameplay review.
WebGL cardinal review showed sparse edge-on branch discs.
Fixed whorls removed random yaw but still read as disconnected dark shelves around a flat pole. The accepted crown is one deterministic descending branch composition crossed only for camera coverage.

rejections.delivery: conifer bark plate inside crown UV
rejections.reason: The first textured-bark pass let foliage cards sample the new brown tile as obvious rectangular holes. Accepted bark and crown rectangles are disjoint and regression-tested.

The compressed mip chain was vertically opposite the GLB UV convention: conifer crowns sampled the grass cell and bark sampled transparency, producing random hanging sprays and missing trunks. The deterministic cook now bakes TextureLoader-equivalent vertical orientation into every KTX2 mip.
Partial-alpha source texels produced bright strokes around leaf and grass silhouettes in the live WebGPU scene. Production uses a strict 0.85 mask without alpha-to-coverage.

rejections.delivery: broad grass caster with per-type shadow opt-out
rejections.reason: The old 1.9 by 0.8 closed proxy projected as a detached oval, and disabling both grass identities created visibly inconsistent missing shadows among neighbouring clumps. Both types now cast the same narrow 1.55 by 0.38, 24-triangle proxy; only flowerBed retains the explicit low-cover opt-out.
